legenda: Southern Brazilian milonga, gaucho nativist folk, melancholic yet warm and storytelling mood, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese, nylon-string guitar playing a steady milonga bass pattern, bandoneon melodies and a short bandoneon solo, subtle upright bass, sparse bombo leguero percussion, intimate acoustic production, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: Nova versão da milonga do BuraqueiraBench, agora com as doze corujas do guia de campo: as quatro do plano e as oito que entraram em 17/11.
descricao: Milonga com violão e bandoneón sobre o BuraqueiraBench: doze corujas brasileiras, quatro do plano e oito novas, julgando ataques traduzidos para o português.
